flow_ref: User story (not in flow deck OCMS)
code_summary: ocmseserviceui pages/Furnish/Acknowledgement.ts (Print) and ocmseserviceapi workflows/receipt (payment receipt PDF) as foundations of other features that are not counted. No bank account submission details or acknowledgement PDF code in any of the six repos
note: Status in stories.json: No requirement (URA's requirement text is not given). The story asks that after a successful submission the page shows the submission details and lets the offender view/download the acknowledgement page as PDF. There is no bank account submission code, so there are no submission details and no acknowledgement PDF for it. Similar mechanisms exist but belong to other features: the Print button (window.print) in Furnish/Acknowledgement.ts:139-143 and payment receipt PDF generation POST /v1/printslip (ReceiptController.java:38, ReceiptServiceImplement.java:50). Neither is about bank accounts, so they are rated Tidak ada code and only noted as reusable foundations. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim. The bank account submission details page and acknowledgement PDF do not exist. The furnish Print and payment receipt PDF could be reused patterns but are not evidence for this story

steps.step: After a successful submission, the page displays the submission details (the bank data sent)
steps.detail: The furnish Acknowledgement page (Furnish/Acknowledgement.ts:233-241) shows a furnish driver submission summary, not a bank account. A generic feature exists but is not what the story names; there is no bank submission to display.

steps.step: The offender can view the acknowledgement page in PDF format
steps.detail: The Print button in Furnish/Acknowledgement.ts:139-143 only calls window.print() for a furnish submission; there is no PDF view for bank accounts. Not counted.

steps.step: The offender can download the acknowledgement PDF for record purposes
steps.detail: POST /v1/printslip (ReceiptController.java:38) with generateReceiptPdf (ReceiptServiceImplement.java:50) builds a payment receipt PDF per notice, not a bank account acknowledgement. A generic mechanism exists but is not what the story names. Not counted.
